newsitem.title: FINLAND: Bourse says halts trade in Stockmann.
newsitem.headline: Bourse says halts trade in Stockmann.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange said on Tuesday it had halted trade in shares of retail group Oy Stockmann Ab pending the release of its first-half earnings report.
"Trade in the share has been halted, it is not suspended," a bourse spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone.

She said the bourse had asked Stockmann to immediately release the interim report after the Finnish news agency STT reported that the group's first-half pre-tax profit rose to 161.7 million markka. The results had been due for release at 1400/1100 GMT.
Before trade was halted, Stockmann's B share rose 8.00 markka or nearly three percent to 280.00 markka. Volume was very thin at 650 shares. The company's A share was untraded.
